name: Workyard Cellar - The Moonward Watch
subtitle: Original generated 8-bit artwork  vs  Blender-authored framed wall asset
review_note: The Blender result preserves the crisp knight, tower, crescent-moon silhouette and warm limited-palette readability while fitting the artwork into a restrained hand-hewn oak cellar frame.
improve: Confirm the picture remains legible at the elevated gameplay camera and that its former-hearth wall bay is unobstructed.
